recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a blonde woman centered within a large circular cutout. The subject wears a black sleeveless bodysuit, long black patent leather gloves, and vibrant blue tights that match the surrounding wall. The lighting is flat and bright, creating a graphic, almost two-dimensional pop-art effect against a deep blue and white backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular frame creates a 'portal' effect, isolating the subject from the blue environment.
The blue tights create a visual bridge between the subject and the outer background wall.
The black gloves and bodysuit provide a high-contrast anchor against the white interior circle.
The subject's vertical pose with crossed arms above the head mimics the circular geometry.
coreInvariants: Vibrant cerulean blue as the primary environment color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, full-body figure occupying the vertical diameter of the circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the black bodysuit and the white circular background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the crossed hands at the top, follows the long blonde hair down to the torso, and terminates at the crossed feet at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large, clean areas of white within the circle and solid blue outside the circle maintain focus on the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues, extreme value contrast between the black garments and white background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to Blue, White, Black, and natural skin/hair tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio setting with a solid cerulean blue wall featuring a large, perfectly circular white cutout in the center. The lighting should be even and bright.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Position a model in the center of the white circle wearing a black bodysuit, long black patent leather gloves, and blue tights that match the wall color exactly.

verificationChecks: Is the blue of the tights an exact match for the blue wall?
Is the subject perfectly centered within the circular frame?
Are the black textures glossy and reflective?
Is the lighting flat enough to maintain a graphic pop-art feel?

adjustableVariables: Circle diameter relative to the frame
Shade of blue (e.g., cobalt vs. cerulean)
Model's pose (e.g., arms down vs. arms up)
Texture of the black garments (matte vs. gloss)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the circular cutout
Professional studio lighting without harsh shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the circular frame is a perfect geometric shape.
Verify the black gloves have a distinct patent leather sheen.
Check that the blue tights blend seamlessly with the outer background color.
Confirm the vertical symmetry of the pose.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place a high-contrast subject in black against a white circular 'portal' set into a monochromatic wall that matches the subject's lower-body clothing.
